subject: Renewal: proposed retainer & commit adjustments for Zenith Health
content:
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
To: tbaxter@zenithhealth.com, lina.gomez@zenithhealth.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal proposal — retainer + commit options for Zenith Health

Hi Tom, Lina —

Thanks again for the renewal conversation last week. Attached is an initial proposal for an updated retainer-based model and a couple of commit options that map to your expected Q4+ usage. The goal is to:
- give Zenith predictable unit cost for the bulk of traffic,
- provide credits that protect you from short-term spikes, and
- offer a short price-hold window to smooth the calendar transition during procurement.

Key points in the attached "proposed-retainer-2027.pdf":
- Option A (Base retainer): 250k tokens/month committed; unit price $0.0035/token; 5% volume credit bank for overage in the same billing quarter.
- Option B (Growth commit): 350k tokens/month committed; unit price $0.00315/token (10% off list); additional 25k token cushion for first two months as one-time credit.
- 3-month price hold on the agreed unit price if you sign by Aug 31, 2026.
- Quarterly usage review and an ROI checkpoint to discuss moving to a Dedicated plan if sustained growth warrants it.

Can you confirm whether Option B's cushion and the 3-month price hold address procurement's concerns about rate volatility? If so, I can prepare a PO-ready doc and a DocuSign envelope. Also attaching a short usage export so you can validate the proposed commit with your finance team (Zenith_Q3_usage_summary.xlsx).

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Red wood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

---

On Wed, 04 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -0700, Tom Baxter <tbaxter@zenithhealth.com> wrote:

> From: Tom Baxter <tbaxter@zenithhealth.com>
> To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
> Cc: lina.gomez@zenithhealth.com, procurement@zenithhealth.com
> Date: Wed, Aug 4, 2026 at 11:22 AM -0700
> Subject: Re: Renewal proposal — retainer + commit options for Zenith Health
>
> Jasmine — thanks for the writeup. A couple items from Procurement and Finance: 
> 1) Procurement wants a stronger discount if we increase our commit materially — they're pushing for at least a 15% concession if we go to 450k tokens/mo (this is a 80% increase). Can you run the math for a 450k commit?
> 2) Finance is worried about price exposure in Nov/Dec (we expect a product campaign). The 3-month price hold helps, but can you extend the hold to 6 months if we sign now?
> 3) We'll need a PO template. Lina will shepherd that internally.
>
> Also, small ask — can we get a short note that the token definitions and counting method will remain the same as our current contract? We don't want to re-open the metering conversation.
>
> Tom
> Director, Platform Ops
> Zenith Health
>

---

From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal proposal — negotiation asks from Zenith (procurement wants 450k commit + longer hold)

Team — forwarding Zenith's asks. Quick recommendations below before I reply:

1) If they increase to 450k tokens/month (80% vs Base), we can offer a two-tiered discount:
   - 350k–449k: unit price $0.00315/token (10% off list)
   - 450k+: unit price $0.00298/token (15% off list)
   - Commitment must be annual (12-month term) for the 15% rate.

2) Price hold: counter with a 4-month firm hold instead of 6 months, tied to signature by Aug 31. We can include a 2-month extension as a non-binding goodwill clause to be evaluated at the Q4 usage checkpoint.

3) Credits: instead of an oversized cushion, propose a one-time 30k token credit usable in the first two months post-signature, plus a 5% quarterly overage credit bank.

4) Metering confirmation: confirm in writing that tokenization/metering follows the current contract appendix (no change).

5) Procurement/Finance ask for PO template: attach a PO draft and a short paragraph that can go into procurement's contract exhibits. I attached the draft PO (Zenith_PO_draft.docx) and the updated proposal PDF (proposed-retainer-2027.pdf).

Next steps I suggest: I take the revised proposal to Zenith and offer the 15% threshold at 450k (annual commit), 4-month hold, and the credits above. Rishi — do we want to include a small onboarding discount (one-time invoice credit) to accelerate signature?

Thanks —
Jasmine

---

Subject: Finalized renewal terms & PO — Zenith Health (attached)

Tom, Lina —

Thanks for the candid asks and patience while we worked this through internally. Attached is the updated proposal and a PO draft that your procurement team can use. Summary of agreed terms below (reflects our counter):

- Annual term (12 months) starting upon signature.
- Commit tiers:
  * Tier 1: 250k tokens/month — $0.0035/token (base)
  * Tier 2: 350k–449k tokens/month — $0.00315/token (10% off)
  * Tier 3: 450k+ tokens/month (annual commit) — $0.00298/token (15% off)
- One-time 30k token credit applied in the first two billing cycles after start date.
- 4-month firm price hold on the agreed unit price if signed by 2026-08-31. Non-binding 2-month goodwill extension to be discussed at Q4 review.
- Metering: token counting and definitions unchanged (per current contract appendix).
- Quarterly usage review with CS (Marissa) and an option to discuss Dedicated migration if sustained growth >20% quarter-over-quarter.

Attachments: proposed-retainer-2027.pdf (updated with Tier 3 pricing) and Zenith_PO_draft.docx (editable PO). For signature convenience I've also created a DocuSign envelope (link below).
